title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：stuff　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stuff 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the grandmother ① sorted the stuff that no child in the courtyard would have measured, and he said the sorting was the whole of the year. The ② stuff, meaning the material itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; stuff, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ bit of stuff in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ stuff at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Stuff, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the grandmother said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the stuff was the whole of the matter, meaning the value and not the material. The ⑥ stuff, meaning the value and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; stuff, he said, is either something you sort or the only word that means both material and a value. He said the value is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ stuff had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ stuff of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of measuring; stuff, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ stuff I remember is the stuff measured in the diary, which closed in 1983 and is still measured as the quietest in the courtyard. ⑩ Stuff, my mother said in 1985, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all stuff, she said, is a value that has agreed to look like material. She said the value was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 东西；材料（指院子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 东西；材料（指那堆东西本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：sort the stuff 整理这一堆东西
D. n. 东西；材料（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 东西之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的东西之事）
F. n. 东西；材料（指日记里写到、被测量的那一堆）
G. n. 东西、价值（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 价值（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sorted the stuff that no child in the courtyard would have measured
The stuff, meaning the material itself and not the lamp
Every bit of stuff in that courtyard
the stuff at the far window
the stuff was the whole of the matter
the stuff had become a line in a diary
The stuff of the whole thing

answers.why: sort the stuff 意为“整理这一堆东西”，1976 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯测量的一堆东西做了一遍。
stuff 意为“东西；材料”，指那堆东西本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被测量。
stuff 意为“东西；材料”，指院子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
stuff 意为“东西；材料”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
stuff 意为“东西、价值”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这堆价值就是那件事的全部。
stuff 意为“价值”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那堆东西，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
stuff 意为“东西；材料”，指日记里写到、被测量的那一堆，到 1981 年这一堆成了日记里的一行。
stuff 意为“东西之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的东西之事是一处院子和三个年头的测量。
stuff 意为“东西；材料”，我记得的是日记里测量过的那一堆，1983 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一堆。
stuff 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，东西是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的东西。
